say:1:1360237001:0.text: After wrapping things up in Land of Riches, you head back to Cedartown...
say:1:1360237001:0.source_cn: 一切告一段落，你们返回了雪松镇……

say:3:1360237002:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, welcome back! This whole area has been completely purified!
say:3:1360237002:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, welcome back! This whole area has been completely purified!
say:3:1360237002:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, welcome back! This whole area has been completely purified!

say:4:1360237003:1.text: I've touched base with Lyca and Bryon. There were some issues in the Dark Forest and Vaduso Mountains, but nothing serious.
say:4:1360237003:1.source_cn: 我也给姐姐和布莱恩他们去了风讯，薄暮丛林和瓦度索山脉有...

say:5:1360237004:1.text: Everything's fine now. After all, no distortions could slip past their sharp ears!
say:5:1360237004:1.source_cn: 而且他们俩的耳朵都特别灵，绝对不会错过任何一点变化，所...

say:6:1360237005:1.text: How about your side? Were there many areas affected?
say:6:1360237005:1.source_cn: 你们那边怎么样？受害的地方很多吗？

say:7:1360237006:1.text: You give Dunlingr and the rest a full rundown on everything that happened, including Berial's schemes.
say:7:1360237006:1.source_cn: 你们告知了顿里尔他们此前发生的一切，以及贝利尔的计划与阴谋。

say:8:1360237007:1.text: Hmm... So he actually went through all this trouble just to play a tune for the sealed Hypogeans...
say:8:1360237007:1.source_cn: 唔，居然是要给被封印的诸多恶魔送上一首问候的音乐，所以...

say:9:1360237008:1.text: Lorsan, don't sympathize with Berial! He's nothing but a liar!
say:9:1360237008:1.source_cn: 洛、洛桑，你可不要心软呀！贝利尔那家伙嘴里都是谎言！

say:11:1360237009:0.text: That's right. Hypogeans don't know good from evil, nor do they have true emotions.
say:11:1360237009:0.source_cn: 没错，恶魔并不存在所谓的好恶，也谈不上拥有情感。

say:12:1360237010:1.text: Everything they do is driven by their twisted desires.
say:12:1360237010:1.source_cn: 一切都只是混乱而疯狂的欲望扭曲后的表象。

say:13:1360237011:1.text: You must listen to the sound of nature and become one with the wind, young man.
say:13:1360237011:1.source_cn: 年轻的风语者啊，汝需要聆听自然的声音，与风融为一体。

say:14:1360237012:0.text: As a talented minstrel, you should inspire others with your music and emotions.
say:14:1360237012:0.source_cn: 汝同样是优秀的吟游诗人，需要用情感与音乐打动他人的内心。

say:15:1360237013:1.text: Ah, it's kind of you to say that...

say:16:1360237014:0.text: But I must remind you—no, warn you—not to judge Hypogeans by human standards.
say:16:1360237014:0.source_cn: 但吾需要提示……不，警告汝，不要用人类的标准去考量恶魔。

say:17:1360237015:1.text: Once you allow even the slightest emotional opening, their corruption will seep in and utterly destroy you.
say:17:1360237015:1.source_cn: 只要汝为他们打开些许情感的空隙，他们的污秽就会乘虚而入...

say:18:1360237016:1.text: I appreciate your wise words, Dunlingr. And of course, Hammie too!
say:18:1360237016:1.source_cn: 多谢您的提示，顿里尔大人。当然，还有漫漫！

say:19:1360237017:1.text: But I'm not that weak! Bryon can back me up on that!
say:19:1360237017:1.source_cn: 不过，你们也太小看我了吧，我姑且也是风语者，意志可是很...

say:21:1360237018:1.text: Are you sure his presence won't make you seem weaker?

say:22:1360237019:1.text: Hey, cut me some slack! Actually, Berial's actions made me realize something.
say:22:1360237019:1.source_cn: 不要批评我啦。我刚刚其实是在想，贝利尔的行动反而给我提...

say:23:1360237020:1.text: All of us—<style="stress"><player_name></style>, Eironn, and I—have been traveling around this continent for quite some time now.
say:23:1360237020:1.male: All of us—<style="stress"><player_name></style>, Eironn, and I—have been traveling around this continent for quite some time now.
say:23:1360237020:1.female: All of us—<style="stress"><player_name></style>, Eironn, and I—have been traveling around this continent for quite some time now.

say:24:1360237021:1.text: It should be spring by now, right? Although it's still freezing in Cedartown, we'll start to see more vibrancy as we travel to other places.
say:24:1360237021:1.source_cn: 如今已经是春天了吧？虽然这里还是一样的冷，但一旦踏上旅...

say:25:1360237022:1.text: How about we hold a celebration?
say:25:1360237022:1.source_cn: 所以我在想，要不要庆祝一下呢？

say:26:1360237023:1.text: Something like the Winter Carnival, but with a touch of spring!
say:26:1360237023:1.source_cn: 就像是隆冬节一样，举行一场春日节？

say:28:1360237024:1.text: Good idea! We should definitely do something to liven up this place!
say:28:1360237024:1.source_cn: 好主意！这里这么冷，就应该尽量火热起来！

say:29:1360237025:1.text: Wouldn't it be nice to hold a combat tournament here? Cedartown is the ideal arena!
say:29:1360237025:1.source_cn: 不如就在这里来一场雪松镇春日擂台赛吧！看，这里多适合比武！

say:31:1360237026:1.text: Madam Gerda, your Mauler side is showing...
say:31:1360237026:1.source_cn: ……老板娘，你还真不愧是蛮血出身啊。

say:33:1360237027:1.text: Sorry, Madam Gerda, but I'll have to put your idea on hold for now.
say:33:1360237027:1.source_cn: 不不，抱歉啦，老板娘，你的创意只能等下次了。

say:34:1360237028:1.text: Because I've just come up with the theme for the festival—<style="highlight">music</style>!
say:34:1360237028:1.source_cn: 因为刚刚我已经想好节日的主题了，那就是——<style...

say:36:1360237029:1.text: Y-you really fell for Berial's trick, didn't you?!
say:36:1360237029:1.source_cn: 你、你果然还是上了贝利尔的当吧？！

say:37:1360237030:1.text: No, please hear me out—music is what dispels the chaos caused by Berial, right?
say:37:1360237030:1.source_cn: 不，你们反过来想一想，虽然贝利尔制造了各种混乱，但最终...

say:38:1360237031:1.text: The sounds of lutes, war drums, people singing, and flutes...

say:39:1360237032:1.text: Merlin has sealed countless Hypogeans across the continent and brought new music to this land.
say:39:1360237032:1.source_cn: 梅林巡游大陆，封印了无数的恶魔，而这一次，又带来了新的乐声。

say:40:1360237033:1.text: And that music seems to herald the arrival of spring!
say:40:1360237033:1.source_cn: 再加上这个时间，简直就像是春天伴随着梅林到来一样！

say:41:1360237034:1.text: We should make this day special!
say:41:1360237034:1.source_cn: 所以，我们来创造一个新的节日吧？

say:42:1360237035:1.text: To commemorate how Merlin drives away the Hypogeans with music and to celebrate the arrival of spring!
say:42:1360237035:1.source_cn: 纪念梅林用音乐驱除了恶魔！春天的节日！

choice_prompt:43:1360237035.text: To commemorate how Merlin drives away the Hypogeans with music and to celebrate the arrival of spring!
choice_prompt:43:1360237035.source_cn: 纪念梅林用音乐驱除了恶魔！春天的节日！

say:45:1360237036:0.text: You deserve the honor, Merlin. As the Windwhisperer said, your actions are truly commendable.
say:45:1360237036:0.source_cn: 不必谦虚，梅林，正如这位风语者所说，汝之行动正应获得如...
say:45:1360237036:0.male: You deserve the honor, Merlin. As the Windwhisperer said, your actions are truly commendable.
say:45:1360237036:0.female: You deserve the honor, Merlin. As the Windwhisperer said, your actions are truly commendable.

say:46:1360237038:0.text: I have a suggestion—the festival theme doesn't always have to be about music.
say:46:1360237038:0.source_cn: 吾有一个建议。如果是这样的节日，今后的主题或许可以不仅...

say:47:1360237039:0.text: Anything that Hypogeans detest could be a theme.
say:47:1360237039:0.source_cn: 恶魔所厌恶的，描绘着美好神圣事物的一切，或许都可以成为主题。

say:48:1360237040:0.text: Dance, painting, poetry, drama, and the genuine happiness people harbor...
say:48:1360237040:0.source_cn: 舞蹈、绘画，诗歌、戏剧，还有人们发自内心的喜悦与幸福——

say:49:1360237041:1.text: Ah, it's like an art festival! Fabulous!
say:49:1360237041:1.source_cn: 啊，那就像是艺术节一样！太棒了！

say:50:1360237042:1.text: How should we name this festival?
say:50:1360237042:1.source_cn: 那么，这样的节日，应该叫什么名字呢？

say:52:1360237043:1.text: Let's name it after the Magister! <style="stress"><player_name></style> Festival it is!
say:52:1360237043:1.male: Let's name it after the Magister! <style="stress"><player_name></style> Festival it is!
say:52:1360237043:1.female: Let's name it after the Magister! <style="stress"><player_name></style> Festival it is!

say:53:1360237044:1.text: Hang on, the Magister uses different names from time to time. Let's just call it "Merlin Festival"!
say:53:1360237044:1.source_cn: 不不，主人会经常改自己的称呼吧！还是叫梅林节就好！
say:53:1360237044:1.male: Hang on, the Magister uses different names from time to time. Let's just call it "Merlin Festival"!
say:53:1360237044:1.female: Hang on, the Magister uses different names from time to time. Let's just call it "Merlin Festival"!

say:55:1360237045:1.text: If you ask me, "Art Festival" is good too! Martial arts can be considered an art too, right?
say:55:1360237045:1.source_cn: 我是觉得艺术节就足够了！说起来，武术也算艺术吧？

say:56:1360237046:1.text: The only thing I could think of is "Spring Festival", but it's pretty basic...
say:56:1360237046:1.source_cn: 我想的是春日庆典，但感觉好像没什么特色……

say:57:1360237047:1.text: What's your take on this, Dunlingr?

say:59:1360237048:1.text: I think Merlin should call the shots. The festival is created in his honor, after all.
say:59:1360237048:1.source_cn: 吾认为，既然是梅林带来的节日，那不妨由梅林挑选，或者干...
say:59:1360237048:1.male: I think Merlin should call the shots. The festival is created in his honor, after all.
say:59:1360237048:1.female: I think Merlin should call the shots. The festival is created in her honor, after all.

say:60:1360237049:1.text: You've got a point! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
say:60:1360237049:1.male: You've got a point! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
say:60:1360237049:1.female: You've got a point! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?

narration:61:1360238001:0.text: At the joyous moment, you can't help but recall the voice you heard when you regained consciousness.
narration:61:1360238001:0.source_cn: 面对着大家期待的眼光，你却不禁回想起了，自己在苏醒的时...
narration:61:1360238001:0.male: At the joyous moment, you can't help but recall the voice you heard when you regained consciousness.
narration:61:1360238001:0.female: At the joyous moment, you can't help but recall the voice you heard when you regained consciousness.

narration:62:1360238002:1.text: "Merlin, your adventure will bring the light of dawn to Esperia..."
narration:62:1360238002:1.male: "Merlin, your adventure will bring the light of dawn to Esperia..."
narration:62:1360238002:1.female: "Merlin, your adventure will bring the light of dawn to Esperia..."

say:67:1360239002:1.text: That's a great name! It sounds sacred, vibrant, and artistic at the same time!
say:67:1360239002:1.source_cn: 不错啊，这个名字！又神圣，又有春天的昂扬气息，而且又能...
say:67:1360239002:1.male: That's a great name! It sounds sacred, vibrant, and artistic at the same time!
say:67:1360239002:1.female: That's a great name! It sounds sacred, vibrant, and artistic at the same time!

say:68:1360239003:1.text: We'll celebrate the Dawnlight Revelry here tomorrow! Let the preparations begin!
say:68:1360239003:1.source_cn: 那么，就决定叫晨辉节了，我们组织一下，明天就在这里过节！

say:71:1360237037:0.text: Exactly. Your actions are truly commendable, Merlin.
say:71:1360237037:0.source_cn: 正是如此，梅林，汝之行动值得这样的夸赞。
say:71:1360237037:0.male: Exactly. Your actions are truly commendable, Merlin.
say:71:1360237037:0.female: Exactly. Your actions are truly commendable, Merlin.
